“你就是刘显？”

秦朗大马金刀地坐在刘显对面，姿态跟他在审讯室里时一模一样。

----当然，他的态度就没有对待自己时那么友好了。

那眼睛一眯，林舒都怕刘显一句话说不对，秦朗就直接冲上去把他的头给拧下来。

“我......”

刘显很慌。

他的声音颤抖，脸上的肌肉也在颤抖，踩在地上的双脚也在颤抖。

这帮人是干什么的？！

带着枪，还是长枪。

抓人不讲规矩，一脚就把房门踹开。

进门之后连问都不问，两个大逼斗就把自己扇晕了，绑在椅子上之后才开始问话......

这可不是公安的风格！

有那么一瞬间，刘显甚至都以为，这是上面老板派来的雇佣兵，是要给自己点教训。

可转念一想，这他么是个什么国家？

就算你再狂，也不可能狂到拿着真枪招摇过市。

所以，对面大概率还是官方的人。

只是或许，他们不是自己接触过的“普通官方力量”......

招，还是不招？

刘显的恐惧已经达到了顶峰，但一瞬间，他突然想到一个问题。

不是，你们抓我总得有个理由吧？

我啥都没干，你们抓我干嘛？？

是，我确实已经做了一些事情。

但我做的事情......你们抓得到吗？！

刘显心定了。

他仍然是一副满脸恐惧的样子，但话却说得顺畅了许多。

“我......我是刘显......你们是谁？你们找我干什么？”

“我警告你们不要乱来，这里都有天网的，警察等下就来了！”

“......还在装傻？”

秦朗皱了皱眉头。

“你以为我们是怎么找到你的？你做了什么，你自己心里没数吗？”

“我做什么了？？”

刘显故作疑惑。

“我只是过来旅游的......”

“旅游？”

秦朗打断道：

“是来杀人的吧。”

刘显的心脏猛地一跳----对方知道的事情似乎比自己预想的还要多。

但没关系，他们没有证据......

“什么杀人！你不要乱说啊！”

“我杀谁了？？我根本什么都没干！”

“你看我像是能杀人的人吗？我都不知道你在说什么......”

秦朗已经开始烦了。

他摇头叹了口气道：

“都是千年的狐狸，你跟我谈什么聊斋？”

“非要我说破吗？”

“4月14号，你来到了茶城。”

“你是带着任务来的----你的目的是杀掉一个叫林舒的人。”

“他们没有给你具体的照片，对吧？”

“要是你看到照片你就应该知道，你的目标，就站在你面前。”

秦朗稍稍向林舒转了转头，林舒不动声色地看着对面的刘显，缠在手腕上的蛇嘶嘶地吐着信子。

刘显当然是看不到这条蛇的。

但他能感觉到，房间里弥漫着的那种隐隐约约的冷气。

“我......我......”

形势再一次逆转，刘显张着嘴，说不出话来。

这些人连自己的目标都知道，那他们岂不是......什么都知道？

"Are you Liu Xian?"

Qin Lang sat across from Liu Xian with a golden sword, his posture was exactly the same as when he was in the interrogation room.

----Of course, his attitude is not as friendly as when he treats himself.

As soon as his eyes narrowed, Lin Shu was afraid that if Liu Xian said something wrong, Qin Lang would rush forward and twist off his head.

"I..."

Liu Xian was panicked.

His voice trembled, the muscles in his face trembled, and his feet on the ground trembled.

What do these people do?!

With a gun, or a long gun.

They didn't follow the rules when arresting people, and they would just kick the door open.

After entering the door, they didn't even ask. The two big guys slapped themselves unconscious and tied them to a chair before they started asking...

This is not the police style!

For a moment, Liu Xian even thought that these were mercenaries sent by the boss above to teach him a lesson.

But then I thought about it, what kind of country is this?

No matter how crazy you are, you can't be crazy enough to show off with a real gun.

Therefore, there is a high probability that the person on the other side is an official.

It's just that maybe they are not the "ordinary official forces" that they have come into contact with...

To recruit or not to recruit?

Liu Xian's fear had reached its peak, but for a moment, he suddenly thought of a question.

No, there must be a reason for you to arrest me, right?

I didn't do anything, why are you arresting me??

Yes, I did do something.

But what I did...can you catch me?!

Liu Xian was determined.

He still had a look of fear on his face, but his words became much smoother.

"I...I am Liu Xian...who are you? What are you looking for me for?"

"I'm warning you not to mess around. Skynet is here. The police will be here soon!"

"...Still pretending to be stupid?"

Qin Lang frowned.

"How do you think we found you? Don't you know what you did?"

"What did I do??"

Liu Xian pretended to be confused.

"I just came here for a trip..."

"Travel?"

Qin Lang interrupted:

"He's here to kill people."

Liu Xian's heart skipped a beat - the other party seemed to know more than he expected.

But that's okay, they have no proof...

"What kind of murder! Don't talk nonsense!"

"Who did I kill?? I didn't do anything at all!"

"Do you think I am someone who can kill people? I don't even know what you are talking about..."

Qin Lang was already getting annoyed.

He shook his head and sighed:

"We are all thousand-year-old foxes, what are you talking about with me?"

"Do you have to tell me?"

"On April 14th, you came to the tea city."

"You came with a mission - your purpose is to kill a man named Lin Shu."

"They didn't give you specific pictures, right?"

"If you saw the photo, you would know that your target is standing right in front of you."

Qin Lang turned his head slightly towards Lin Shu. Lin Shu looked at Liu Xian opposite him calmly. The snake wrapped around his wrist hissed and spit out the letter.

Of course Liu Xian couldn't see the snake.

But he could feel the vague air-conditioning permeating the room.

"I...I..."

The situation was reversed again. Liu Xian opened his mouth and was speechless.

These people even know their own goals, so don’t they know... everything?
